[{"step": 1, "file": "src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 51, "var": "static_data", "code": "memcpy(static_data, data, size)", "note": "Attacker-controlled input is copied into the global static_data buffer of 32768 bytes"}, {"step": 2, "file": "src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 53, "var": "config", "code": "config = config_open_for_fuzzing(static_data, size)", "note": "config_open_for_fuzzing passes size-1 to config_init_data, setting lexer end to static_data + size - 1"}, {"step": 3, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_config", "line": 458, "var": "chr", "code": "if (chr == '\\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"''\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string", "note": "The opening ''' triggers lex_multiline_string, which searches for the closing '''"}, {"step": 4, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 345, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)", "note": "When the closing ''' is not found before the buffer end, strncmp reads 3 bytes past the static_data buffer boundary, causing a global-buffer-overflow READ 3"}]
TRACE_EOF` executed with exit code 0.
